High-speed VPN

Encrypt your internet activity, regain your online privacy, and access your favorite content with the leading VPN service. Connect to over 3,400 HDD and RAM-only VPN servers spread across 150+ locations worldwide.

Advanced Privacy Features

Our advanced privacy features include a SOCKS5 proxy for IP address anonymity, a VPN Kill Switch to prevent data exposure if the connection drops, and Split Tunneling for optimal balance between security and performance.

Unlimited Devices

Secure every device you own from one IPVanish account. Whether it’s a desktop, tablet, mobile phone, smart TV, or router, the VPN will shield your IP address and encrypt your internet traffic.

Customer Service

Get instant help with troubleshooting and billing via our 24/7 live chat. We also offer ’round-the-clock support through email updates and hundreds of self-help guides in our comprehensive Support Center.

Money-back Guarantee

Try IPVanish absolutely risk-free. All Yearly and 2-Year plans come with a 30-day money-back guarantee, allowing you to request a full refund if you cancel within the first 30 days. Monthly plans are ineligible.

5GB eSIM

Get a one-time code for 5GB of eSIM data with aloSIM, valid in the country of your choice.

Threat Protection Pro

NEW!

Real-time protection that detects and stops malware, ransomware, and unsafe downloads. Always-on security keeps your computer protected—even when your VPN is off.

Secure Browser™

Access the internet securely from a remote browser with built-in VPN protection. This web app and browser extension allows you to access sites from anywhere while isolating potential risks in a virtual environment.

Cloud Backup

Easily back up 1TB of photos, documents, music, and videos from 1 computer, ensuring your data is protected against accidental deletion or technical mishaps.

File Sync & Share

Synchronize data across all devices and securely share files with end-to-end encryption. Collaborate effortlessly and access your data anytime, anywhere.

Phone Support

Receive direct assistance by telephone during regular business hours. Additionally, our team is available 24/7 through live chat and email to help you whenever you need it.

Most people know VPN connections can be sluggish. But our upgraded servers paired with WireGuard® make you forget you’re running a VPN at all!

Frequently asked questions

1. How many devices can VPN be used on?

IPVanish VPN does not meter concurrent connections or app installations, so you can protect every device you own at the same time from one single subscription plan.

2. What devices can be used with VPN?

IPVanish is compatible with most major platforms, including Windows, macOS, Apple TV, Fire TV, Android, iOS, Chrome OS, visionOS, and Linux. Smart electronics and non-native IoT devices can use the VPN through an IPVanish-enabled router.

3. What payment methods are available?

You can pay with your credit card (VISA, Discover, American Express, Mastercard, Union Pay, Diners Club), PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and Amazon Pay.

4. How much does IPVanish cost?

Most IPVanish subscription plans start with an introductory rate for the first term. After that, both Yearly and 2-Year plans renew at $99.99/year (Essential) or $129.99/year (Advanced). Note that 2-Year plans renew on a Yearly cycle once the first term ends. You can view the full list of renewal prices at any time.

Essential
• Monthly: $14.99 (retail value)
• Yearly: $179.88 (retail value) — renews at $99.99/year
• 2-Year: $359.76 (retail value) — renews at $99.99/year
Advanced
• Monthly: $17.99 (retail value)
• Yearly: $215.88 (retail value) — renews at $129.99/year
• 2-Year: $431.76 (retail value) — renews at $129.99/year

5. Are there any VPN discounts or specials?

From time to time, IPVanish VPN offers promotional rates listed on the pricing page and homepage. If an active promotion is not available, new and former customers should check the Coupons page for a discounted offer.

6. Is IPVanish a one-time payment?

All IPVanish plans are subscription-based and automatically renewed. IPVanish currently offers Monthly and Yearly subscription plans, each bill differently:
• The Monthly plan is billed every 30 days;
• The Yearly plan is billed every 12 months;
• The 2-Year plan is billed every 12 months after the initial 2-year term.
